name: Love Letter
variant: 2019 Z-Man edition (21 cards, Spy and Chancellor)

categories.label: Favor tokens
categories.hint: 1 per round win (ties: all tied players gain 1); +1 for sole Spy player still in round at round end.

tiebreakers.description: Game ends when someone reaches the target; several players can win together.

notes: family: round-tokens. Round winner: highest card when deck empties; all tied players win the round (2019 rulebook has no discard-total tiebreak; that rule belongs to the older edition). Target tokens by players: 2p=6, 3p=5, 4p=4, 5-6p=3. Classic 16-card version uses the same targets (2-4 players).

sources.title: Love Letter 2019 Rulebook (Z-Man Games)
sources.section: pp.6-7 End of a Round, Winning the Game; p.13 Spy
